recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. If the work group wants broader payer/payor spelling modernization or a different glossary normalization strategy, that should be handled under a later terminology issue rather than by expanding FHIR-27881.
issue_request: FHIR-27881 was Published with a Not Persuasive with Modification resolution. It declined renaming Coverage.payor to Coverage.payer, but requested updated Coverage.payor wording about the policy issuer or party accepting payment responsibility and requested the Financial Module Glossary definitions for both payer and payor to use the detailed transaction-responsibility definition.
initial_application: Merge commit d10524542f7201a073d3a2e84e0abed57a71fa8b listed FHIR-27881 in PR #2140, and source commit 720258c80a99566e1259c4c1a1dcacd8fbc5abbf applied Coverage changes and added the long payer definition to the Insurer glossary row. However, the explicit Payer and Payor glossary rows still retained the old short definition, 'A public or private insurer.'
additional_context: FHIR-30928 and FHIR-32076 later finalized the R5 Coverage model by renaming the former payor concept to Coverage.insurer and separating non-insurance payment responsibility into Coverage.paymentBy. FHIR-37702 later confirmed that this R5 self-pay/insurance split removed older Coverage.payor cardinality concerns. The Da Vinci Zulip thread that led to the seed supports the Jira decision not to make a breaking base-resource rename after publication.
reconciliation: Updated source/financial-module.html so the Payer and Payor glossary rows now use the same transaction-responsibility definition already present on the Insurer row. No Coverage element hunk was made because the current Coverage.insurer/paymentBy model is intentional later context and already separates issuer identity from payment responsibility.
